S1.text: From Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria, comes a community passionate about opening doors for women in technology. We are PyLadies Rivers.

S2.text: Our mission is simple: to encourage, support and empower women to explore programming, develop practical Python skills, and build confidence in technology.

S3.text: Led by our chapter organizer and mentor, Fredrick Ughimi, PyLadies Rivers is building a welcoming environment where learners can grow together, share knowledge and support one another.

S4.text: Through our structured Python mentorship programme, we guide learners from the fundamentals of programming to practical exercises and assignments. We make learning accessible, interactive and supportive, especially for beginners.

S5.text: We are growing beyond online learning, with hands-on experiences and stronger community connections. We are excited about our upcoming in-person Python workshop in Port Harcourt, planned for February 2027.

S6.text: Whether you are just starting or growing your skills, there is a place for you here. One line of Python at a time, we are creating opportunities for women in technology. We are PyLadies Rivers!
